rv.q: All My Pretty Ones is likely to leave you not only recommending this play to others, but to share the largely unheard story of 10th June 1944 in dedication to the people of Oradour-sur-Glane.
The production at The Birmingham REP struggled to live up to the weight of its subject matter fully.
A haunting piece of theatre and a story that needs to be told.

cn.t: An ambitious, haunting exploration of the Oradour massacre earns praise for its powerful subject matter, though execution proves uneven. Critics find the production deeply moving but struggle with its contemporary framing device.
